sentence: This project builds tool-mounted robots and image-based computer programs to make surgery for spine fractures safer and lower the radiation dose.
This project processes samples to measure which genes are active and what state the chromatin is in, to better understand cancer of the blood.
This project studies how a virus changes the way infected B cells repair their DNA, leading to unstable genomes and cancer.
This project provides animal housing and mouse model services, including gene editing, so that cancer researchers can build and test models of the disease.
This project builds neuromuscular organoids from human stem cells to model amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and finds what goes wrong in their structure and function.
This project tries to find out whether an enzyme called hexokinase 3 shapes how macrophages behave and protects the heart after a heart attack.
This project studies how cells keep their metabolism balanced, using mathematical modeling together with experiments in live cells.
This project builds tools that mine big data to find cancer therapeutics, diagnostics and insights into how cancer works.
This project engineers molecular technology that images many RNA and protein molecules at once in an automated and very sensitive way.
This project tests whether a virtual consultation service with low-cost genomic sequencing helps sick newborns get genomic medicine.
This project tests treatments that target prostate cancer stem cells alongside standard therapies, to try to prevent or delay the disease coming back.
This project develops deep generative models that use early computed tomography images to predict how acute respiratory distress syndrome progresses and responds to treatment.
This project studies how the body forms and handles reactive products made from tryptophan metabolism and how these products affect cell signaling.
This project tries to find out how activating thyroid hormone receptors in the brain changes chromatin and lowers alcohol drinking in mice.
This project covers cancer research from basic research and clinical trials to screening, community outreach and survivorship.
This project uses high-throughput screening to find long RNAs that shape how macrophages respond to the bacterium that causes tuberculosis.
This project tests how oral THC eaten by adolescent mice affects their brain and behavior as adults, and whether cannabidiol lessens the effects.
This project studies which bacterial and host factors cause antibiotics to fail against Staphylococcus aureus infection of bone.
This project images the inner ear of human specimens with optical coherence tomography and builds an endoscope to see its fine structure in patients.
This project builds a framework that links wildlife health, viral burden and human transmission to forecast how animal viruses spill over and cause outbreaks.
